cross-doc drift [root-file-set] -- file(s) at the repository root that the closed set does not name: ['M`']. Both orphans removed alongside this check arrived that way, on a `git add -A` in a commit about something else, and neither was referenced by any document or tool -- so no other check here could ever see them. A deliberate new root file is a one-line addition to ROOT_ALLOWED in tools/validate.py; a scratch file belongs in .gitignore, which this check honours.
